statement: The analysis reads the grantor's rights from every app document the app list names, whether or not the change names its app; a fragment that reaches an app whose document cannot be read is never contained, nor, when the app list is missing, incomplete, unreadable or misses an app document that exists, one that reaches any app the change does not name.

control:ChangesB1Test#an app list that is not to be trusted leaves every app unknown - RC1-4
control:ChangesB1Test#an app document lists itself, and a lost list starts again incomplete - RC1-4
control:ChangesB1Test#the platform's first revision completes the app list only when it names every app document - RC1-4
control:ControlMaintenanceTest#reclamation marks a complete app list incomplete when it misses an app document - RC1-4
control:ChangesB2Test#the first analysis reconciles the app list before it trusts it
control:ChangesB2Test#a failed reconciliation is not tried again by every analysis
